_meta.description: Seed retrieval queries per PHQ-8 topic, phrased the way people actually speak in an interview rather than the way a clinician writes. Used to search the full transcript before any model call, and as the 'already tried' list the interviewer role must not repeat when it expands the query set.
_meta.design: Deliberately corpus-neutral: no DAIC-WOZ-specific wording, so the same file transfers to another interview corpus. Each entry is a short phrase; retrieval scores idf-weighted token overlap plus a verbatim-phrase bonus, so multi-word entries act as soft phrase anchors rather than hard filters.
_meta.note: Appetite or Weight Changes and Psychomotor Changes have no direct interviewer question anywhere in the DAIC-WOZ protocol, so for those two topics these queries plus model-generated expansion are the ONLY route to evidence.

Loss of Interest: stopped doing things i used to love
used to enjoy but not anymore
can't be bothered to do things
hard to get excited about anything
Sleep Problems: wake up in the middle of the night
only get a few hours of sleep
Fatigue or Low Energy: hard to get out of bed
Concentration Difficulties: read the same thing over and over
Psychomotor Changes: everything takes longer than it used to
